media.campaigns_note: Aligned window (2026-03-01 → 2026-09-04). Rows + unattributed = $8,246.59 and 860 conversations exactly. Per-campaign leads count only records carrying a campaign_code (601 of 838), so campaign-level cost per lead is a ceiling.

funnel.source: Firebase /Leads (created ≥ 2026-01-01, n=866; media-origin subset n=838) joined to Postgres inbound messages by contact_id, pulled 2026-09-04

definitions.leads_media_origin: leads_in_crm minus 28 non-media imports created in 2026 (dormant re-activation, manual, reminder-bot backlog). 65 leads recovered from a persistence leak ARE media-origin and stay in. Every engagement figure below is computed on this 838-lead set.
definitions.engaged_1plus: Media-origin lead whose contact sent ≥1 inbound WhatsApp message (Postgres join, not Firebase status). 41 media-origin leads have no contact_id and count as not engaged.
definitions.engaged_2plus: ≥2 inbound messages — replied more than once.
definitions.engaged_5plus: ≥5 inbound messages — in a real conversation.

reported.note: Calls and meetings are RECONSTRUCTED from the iPhone WhatsApp backup (2026-08-23) and Liam's reminder-bot export (2026-09-03) — not from any system of record. Closings are Liam-reported.

reported.closings_note: 2 deals in signing · ฿20.5M · commission ฿1.5M, not yet paid
reported.closings_note_he: 2 עסקאות בחתימה · ฿20.5M · עמלה ฿1.5M, טרם שולם
reported.method: CALLS: the iPhone backup carries WhatsApp's call log (CallHistory.sqlite, business number) with direction, duration and the other party's number; 122 calls since 2026-03-01, of which 94 involve a CRM lead. Cellular calls are not in the backup, so this is a floor. MEETINGS: no system logged them, so two independent sources were merged — lead chats whose text confirms a meeting ("see you at", "thanks for the meeting", "נפגשנו", 31 chats, marketing broadcasts excluded) and the reminder-bot export (29 contacts with a meeting reminder, 70 more flagged on-island or arriving). Union of confirmed sources 31–49; 102 contacts carried meeting intent. CLOSINGS: Thai regulatory changes in 2026 delayed completions; two deals are in signing.
reported.method_he: שיחות: גיבוי האייפון מכיל את יומן השיחות של וואטסאפ (CallHistory.sqlite, המספר העסקי) עם כיוון, משך ומספר הצד השני; 122 שיחות מאז 2026-03-01, מהן 94 עם ליד ב-CRM. שיחות סלולריות אינן בגיבוי, ולכן זו רצפה. פגישות: שום מערכת לא רשמה אותן, ולכן מוזגו שני מקורות בלתי-תלויים — שיחות לידים שהטקסט בהן מאשר פגישה ("נתראה ב", "תודה על הפגישה", "נפגשנו", 31 שיחות, בלי תפוצות שיווקיות) וייצוא הבוטי (29 אנשי קשר עם תזכורת פגישה, ועוד 70 שסומנו באי/מגיעים). איחוד המקורות המאושרים 31–49; ל-102 אנשי קשר הייתה כוונת פגישה. סגירות: שינויי רגולציה בתאילנד ב-2026 עיכבו השלמות; שתי עסקאות בחתימה.

track_record.note: All 17 first-contacts predate the 2026 media pilot; none is attributable to pilot spend. This block proves closing ability, not pilot ROI.

pipeline.note: Two 2026 deals are in signing (฿17M + ฿3.5M, commission ฿1M + ฿0.5M, unpaid); three older deals sit at contract / hot stage. Never counted as sales until completed.
